Brand Introduction

Ergo Essentials provides premium ergonomic furniture designed to improve comfort, health, and productivity at work. Trusted by ergonomists, consultants, and professionals, we focus on solutions that support long-term well-being.


Product Description

We offer a handpicked range of ergonomic chairs, sit-stand desks, and accessories from leading brands including ergoCentric, Ergohuman, Eurotech, Bambach, Adapt (SpaceCo), and Evoluent. Our products support various body types and workstyles for all-day comfort.


Unique Selling Points

  • High AOV (~$700) for strong affiliate potential
  • 5–10% commission rates (based on product SKU)
  • Tiered bonuses up to $750/month
  • Dedicated support and marketing tools
  • Trusted by ergonomic experts and creators


Payment Terms

  • 5–10% commission per sale
  • Bonuses start at $3,000 in monthly sales
  • Monthly payouts via PayPal or bank transfer
  • $100 minimum payout threshold
  • 30-day cookie tracking


Additional Info

  • Access to banners, brochures, images, and videos
  • Discount code tracking available
  • Ideal for ergonomists, influencers, bloggers, YouTubers, and office designers
payout_period: Once initial threshold of $100 is reached, payments will come in on the 10th of each month.

Ergo Essentials Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions

Welcome to the Ergo Essentials Affiliate Program! We appreciate your interest in partnering with us to promote high-quality ergonomic solutions. These terms and conditions outline the rights and responsibilities of both Ergo Essentials ("we" or "merchant") and affiliates ("you" or "affiliate") participating in this program. By registering, you agree to comply with these terms.

1. Approval & Registration

  • We reserve the right to approve or reject any affiliate application at our sole discretion.

  • Affiliates who do not align with our brand values or violate ethical standards may be rejected.

2. Commission Structure & Payouts

2.1 Commission Rates

  • Base commission rate: 5-10% per sale (varies by product SKU).

  • Tiered Bonuses: Additional payouts based on monthly sales volume.

Monthly Attributed Sales Bonus Payout
$3,000 $150 bonus
$8,000 $400 bonus
$15,000 $750 bonus

2.2 Payout Process

  • Payout Frequency: Monthly payments on the 10th of each month.

  • Minimum Payout Threshold: $100.

  • Payment Methods:

    • PayPal

    • Direct bank transfer

    • Any other payment method can be requested by the affiliate and we will do our best to provide it as an option

  • Currency: USD.

3. Affiliate Links & Coupon Codes

  • Affiliate links are automatically generated upon approval.

  • Affiliates can generate links for specific products or collections.

  • Coupon codes are primarily for ergonomists and influencers who prefer direct discount promotion, however we give all our affiliates the option to track via discount code.

  • If a customer clicks an affiliate link and uses a coupon code, only one commission will be applied (not doubled). 

4. Cookie Duration & Tracking

  • Cookie Duration: 30 days (affiliates receive credit if the user completes a purchase within 30 days of clicking their link).

  • Customers who clear cookies or switch devices may not be trackable.

5. Ethical Promotion & Guidelines

5.1 Ethical Promotion & Compliance

  • Prioritize your audience's and clients' best interests.

    • Recommend only chairs that truly fit their needs.

    • Avoid suggesting products that do not align with ergonomic well-being.

  • Disclose your affiliate relationship as per FTC guidelines.

  • Promote products truthfully without misleading claims.

  • Use only approved marketing materials (banners, product images, brochures, etc.).

5.2 Restricted Promotion Methods

Affiliates may not:

  • Run Google Ads or other paid search ads using branded keywords (e.g., "Ergo Essentials").

  • List referral links or codes on coupon or discount websites.

  • Make false or exaggerated claims (e.g., "Cures back pain 100%").

  • Engage in spammy, aggressive, or misleading marketing tactics.

Violation of these guidelines may result in termination from the program and forfeiture of commissions.

6. Tracking & Reporting

6.1 Affiliate Dashboard

  • Affiliates will have access to a real-time dashboard to track:

    • Clicks

    • Conversions

    • Sales and commissions

    • Payout history

6.2 Referral Attribution

  • Sales are tracked via affiliate links & cookies (default method) or discount codes.

  • Affiliates can request to switch between tracking methods based on their marketing approach.

7. Program Support & Marketing Resources

7.1 Dedicated Affiliate Support

  • A dedicated team member is available to assist affiliates with:

    • Strategy optimization

    • Best practices for referrals

    • Tracking & payout questions

7.2 Marketing Materials

Affiliates will receive:

  • High-resolution product images & videos

  • Detailed brochures & spec sheets (ergonomist-focused)

  • Assembly & setup guides

8. Termination & Policy Violations

8.1 Program Termination

  • Either party may terminate participation at any time with written notice.

  • Affiliates who violate the terms (e.g., fraudulent activity, unethical promotion) may be removed without notice.

8.2 Commission Forfeiture

  • Any pending commissions from policy-violating sales will be forfeited.

  • Affiliates with no attributed sales for 6 consecutive months may be removed from the program.

9. Updates & Modifications

  • Ergo Essentials reserves the right to modify these terms at any time.

  • Affiliates will be notified via email 7 days in advance of significant changes.

Acceptance of Terms

By applying to the Ergo Essentials Affiliate Program, you agree to abide by these terms and conditions.
